summary: Iteration 60 — Verified tap-to-add + button restoration on customer product cards across desktop, mobile grid, and mobile row layouts. Desktop /products (1440x900): all 60 product cards render green `+ Add` pill [data-testid=product-add-btn-<id>], h-9 (36px), active:scale-95, contains a real lucide Plus svg (not ASCII). One-tap flow works: cart badge [top-nav-cart-count] went 0→1→2, no page navigation, stepper [product-qty-dec-<id>/product-qty-inc-<id>] replaces the pill, and removing the last unit brings the `+ Add` pill back. aria-label='Add <name> to cart' present. Mobile 390x844: /mart home carousel and /categories/fruits-vegetables both render [m-pc-add-<id>] grid pills with lucide Plus + 'ADD', h-8 (32px), stepper [m-pc-qty-<id>] replaces on tap, bottom-nav cart tab [m-bnav-cart] badge increments. Row layout (toggled via [m-cat-layout] on category page): pill is h-9 (36px), contains lucide Plus svg, aria-label present, tap adds to cart and swaps to stepper. Regression pass — no console errors, MobileHome/ProductListPage/MobileCategoryPage all render fine.

ui_bugs.issue: The grid-layout `+ ADD` pill is missing an aria-label. Review request explicitly requires 'all + Add buttons have aria-label including the product name'. Only the row layout and desktop got the aria-label added; the grid variant at MobileProductCard.jsx line 89 still has none.

action_items: Add `aria-label={`Add ${product.name} to cart`}` to the grid-layout button in /app/frontend/src/components/mobile/MobileProductCard.jsx (line 89) to match the row and desktop variants.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileProductCard grid button (line 89) is the only add-to-cart button in the app without an aria-label — inconsistent with the accessibility acceptance criteria of this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop + mobile add-to-cart pill flow is fully working. Toggle [m-cat-layout] on any /categories/<slug> page switches MobileProductCard between grid and row layouts. Guest cart works — no login required for add-to-cart. Only outstanding item is a missing aria-label on the grid-layout mobile `+ ADD` pill.
